host_execution.scope: Actual opt-in offscreen Vulkan execution under existing finite child/output/reaping bounds; no native surface or browser run

python.scope: Protocol validation and bounded fake Python processes only; no browser/planner/Rust/GPU execution.

offline_wgsl_scope: Both exact shaders, Naga30.0.1 all validation flags, empty capabilities, one compute entry and8x8x1 workgroup; no GPU

first_failures.candidate1: All17Rust1.88 tests passed. StrictClippy refused six single-element loops in scalar oracle tests; direct equivalent assertions preserve inputs/expected values. Only tests.rs changed.
first_failures.wgsl_checker: Initial lld could not create a worker thread under checker resource limits. Same checker/shaders linked with --threads=1 and passed; original failure retained.

browser_regression_reuse.scope: Reuse source-identical browser evidence; no new browser execution assigned to this probe-only change.

limitations: Opaque nearest-neighbor image subset only; no text, blending, rounded coverage, opacity groups or full image/CSS/color-space conformance.
Explicit GPU-buffer sum excludes CPU inputs/plans/expected outputs, native upload staging and driver/device/pipeline allocations; no total allocator proof.
No process isolation for driver calls; synchronous driver/poll/drop/spawn internals and uninterruptible cleanup are not proven finitely complete.
Separate ordered compute passes preserve overlap but establish no optimization or Chromium performance claim.
Normal browser rendering remains CPU; no native surface or compositor validation in this checkpoint.
